text:
The plate looks like a side plate or dinner plate, roughly 22-26 cm across. Two sushi pieces are on it, each about 3.5-4 cm wide and 3 cm tall, so each weighs roughly 20 g.

One piece is a California roll with imitation crab. The other has orange tobiko or masago with cucumber. The rice, nori and sesame make up most of each piece.

I split the weight between the fillings and the rice.
